summary: Marquee per-page overrides + client-portal (text-only) access verified end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 new pytest tests pass (GET returns pages + pages_list with home first; PUT stores only supplied non-blank fields; range validation for speed/opacity/font_size; 160-char cap; blank string removes an override field; DELETE clears whole page override; public/site exposes marquee.pages; site-wide PUT preserves page overrides; slug path accepted with or without leading slash). Iter91 regression: 17/17 still green. Frontend: /portal MarqueeEditor renders with page selector + top/bottom text fields + Reset, and CORRECTLY hides marquee-speed/marquee-stroke_opacity/marquee-font_size/marquee-enabled-toggle (textOnly). Site Mode /apps/app_testlab -> builder tab shows the full editor with all 8 controls. Public site (/p/pv_c3b797fcdafc58d4e70e320f): with a /t-dental override set, home shows site-wide (ORBIT/ONBOARD), /t-dental shows the override (DENTAL_TOP_XYZ/DENTAL_BOT_XYZ), and /t-healthcare still shows site-wide. Portal save writes only to selected page (verified against admin GET), and Reset clears just that page override. All test overrides cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/marquee.py: put_page_marquee uses `body.dict(exclude_unset=True)` (correct — omitted keys don't touch existing row, blank string removes). The site-wide PUT uses `{k:v for k,v in body.dict().items() if v is not None}` — that means clients can't clear a site-wide field by sending '' at the site-wide level; only by /reset. Not in scope of this feature but worth noting for consistency.
backend/studio.py public_site correctly pops 'pages' out of _own_mq before spreading fallback so page overrides survive across the merge and reach the client (verified).
frontend PublicPreview.tsx merges `mqAll` (site-wide) with `mqAll.pages[slug]` and deletes `mq.pages` before rendering — clean; matches spec.
MarqueeEditor.tsx: `reset()` on slug uses DELETE /marquee/pages{slug} for page reset, POST /marquee/reset for site-wide reset. Toast messaging distinguishes the two cases.
Portal.tsx passes `textOnly compact` — confirmed sliders + toggle are hidden in the DOM (not just visually).
seed_data_creation: Temporary page overrides on app_testlab (/t-dental, /some-other-page, /app-showcase-pro-4) created and deleted during tests. Final state: pages={} (verified).
